requirements.text: When no app root applies (the home view, the editor view with no tab open, or an active tab with no path such as a new unsaved file), the explorer roots at the user's home folder. On Windows the level above any folder root is a list of the available drives; Up from a root folder climbs one level at a time and from a drive reaches the drive list. Changing the root never closes or changes any open tab.

In the app view, F5 runs the same Start all / Stop all action as the app's on-screen button, choosing Start or Stop exactly as the button would at the moment F5 is pressed. Non-executable terminals are skipped (see R11). In the home and editor views F5 does nothing: it does not refresh, start or stop anything, or change the view. F5 never refreshes on any modifier combination. This supersedes the earlier accepted requirement 20261125-153618:R4, which promised that F5 refreshes: the old F5-refresh action, the F5 shortcut entry, and every menu, palette and help hint that advertises F5 as refresh are replaced by this requirement, and the tests that asserted F5 means refresh are updated to assert the new behaviour.
In the theme picker's find dialog, the theme rows fit inside the dialog's left and right edges with no horizontal overflow on desktop or mobile widths.

The shared Dialog and every dialog built on it (including the theme finder and the confirmation dialogs) plus the git BranchMenu are presented as responsive side panes from the project's approved jattac responsive-layout package, instead of centred modals. Every existing screen, panel, dialog and the footer remains present, and each dialog keeps the same content, fields, buttons, actions and close paths it has today; only its presentation changes from a centred modal to a side pane. This requirement supersedes the earlier accepted requirement 20261125-153618:R2 only in its promise that no existing dialog is redesigned or replaced: that presentation clause no longer holds for these dialogs, while R2's promise that every existing screen, panel, dialog and the footer is still present keeps holding. The command palette stays a palette and is not moved to a side pane. Before building this part, verify that the package's published build installs cleanly and ships its CSS; if it cannot be used, stop this part and report, and the other requirements still ship.
Ask the core for the user's home folder. The home view and an editor with no file have to show the person's home folder, and the window must not guess or hard-code a Windows path.

Add the approved responsive-layout package and prove it is usable. R8 names the jattac responsive-layout library as the source of the side panes, and an earlier jattac package had to be rejected because its published build shipped no CSS.

Keep focus, Escape and cancel behaviour when dialogs move to the pane. Moving confirmations into a side pane must not make a destructive dialog easier to misfire or impossible to dismiss from the keyboard.

Pin the current dialog and branch menu behaviour before changing them. The shared Dialog and BranchMenu were already shipped, so their current behaviour has to be frozen by tests before their shell is replaced (USR-004).

When no app root applies (the home view, the editor view with no tab open, or an active tab with no path such as a new unsaved file), the explorer roots at the user's home folder. On Windows the level above any folder root is a list of the available drives; Up from a root folder climbs one level at a time and from a drive reaches the drive list. Changing the root never closes or changes any open tab.
